senses.example: Tengo un resfriado desde el lunes.
senses.exampleGloss: I have had a cold since Monday.

alternatives.reason: Everyday Peninsular synonym; often the more colloquial choice.
A heavier illness than a resfriado; not interchangeable.
Peninsular false friend for a blocked nose; in LatAm it can mean constipated.

notes: The resfriado/constipado/gripe triangle is a classic Peninsular trap; keeping the three together is deliberate.
